definition: כִּיס noun masculine Prov 1:14 bag, purse (perhaps kindred with כּוֺס , q. v.; Arabic (probably from Persian Lane 2640 ); Ethiopic Late Hebrew כִּיס ; Aramaic כִּיסָא , , Palmyrene מן כיסה from his purse = at his own expense, Vog p. 13 and others) — bag , in which were carried: \ \ a. weights (see אֶבֶן 5 ) Deut 25:13 ; Mic 6:11 ; Prov 16:11 \ \ b. money, i.e. a purse Isa 46:6 ; Prov 1:14 . כִּיִּר , [ כִּיר ], כִּירַיִם see below I. כור . כִּישׁוֺר see below כשׁר . כָּ֫כָה see below כה above כִּכָּר see below כרר ; כֹּל see below I. כלל .

כִּיס noun masculineProv 1:14 bag, purse (perhaps kindred with כּוֺס, q. v.; Arabic (probably from Persian Lane2640); Ethiopic Late Hebrew כִּיס; Aramaic כִּיסָא, , Palmyrene מן כיסה from his purse = at his own expense, Vogp. 13 and others) — bag, in which were carried:
